title: Magical Transformation! Cinematic sequences!
author: strawberry-ramune
selftext: Magical transformations, cinematic version and short gameplay version, and traveling between maps!

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body:
I saw someone else post their game using VRoid Studio where they got their character from it. Might want to check it out since your main character seems to be an anime magical girl after all and your current model is... oof. I've personally never used VRoid Studio but might consider it if I want a vtuber-looking model. But yeah your 3d magical girl is looking pretty rough and this seems like an easy way to get exactly what you want.

[https://vroid.com/en/studio](https://vroid.com/en/studio)

replies.author: strawberry-ramune
replies.body: Thank you for the recommendation! I took a look at Vroid studio and I think it's a bit too limited for what I'm trying to do since I need something that can sculpt and rig directly in the engine, but I will look into some tools which can do this! I agree the character model needs some work!
